text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, amazing! Still-san,
your mother is a novelist?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually...
a new volume is coming out soon.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: My heart is already fluttering, wondering what kind of story has been woven... Hehe, I can't wait for it to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, a delay in shipping...
No, please do not worry about it."
